heading: Questions about buying for an occasion

items.question: How early should I order for a wedding?
items.answer: As early as you can. Pieces from the trays can be ready sooner than made-to-order pieces, whose timeline we agree in writing with the quote. Message us with the date and we will tell you what fits.

items.question: Do pieces come boxed, and with paperwork?
items.answer: Every piece leaves in a box with its invoice, which states the karat, net gold weight, rate per gram, making charge and 5% VAT. Diamonds are instrument-tested in the shop before they reach the tray, and larger stones come with an independent laboratory grading report that goes in the box with the invoice.

items.question: Can I reserve a piece at a branch?
items.answer: Ask on WhatsApp with the piece reference or a photo and the branch you want to collect from. Pieces move between branches, so give us a day’s notice. The price is set at the rate on the day you pay unless the rate has been booked, so ask whether rate booking is available for your order. During a campaign the offer page states its own booking terms.
